name: Sant Fost de Campsentelles (Spain)
description: Green field with a white flaming beacon at the centre, between two corner triangles at the upper hoist and lower fly with four red pales on yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Sant Fost de Campsentelles; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: beacon with flames, the canting figure of Campsentelles
corner triangles at the upper hoist and lower fly with four red pales on yellow
red pales on the corner triangles
